# Skift

> Skift is a leading travel industry intelligence platform covering global travel trends, business strategies, technology innovations, and market analysis across airlines, hotels, cruise lines, online travel agencies, and destination management.

Skift provides comprehensive coverage of major travel companies including Airbnb, Booking Holdings, Expedia, TUI Group, and emerging markets like India and China. The platform offers research programs, industry analysis, and breaking news on topics ranging from pandemic recovery and digital transformation to sustainable tourism and travel technology mergers and acquisitions.

## Key Topics

- Pandemic recovery and travel industry resilience
- Online travel agencies (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia)
- Cruise industry operations and challenges
- TUI Group transformation and business model evolution
- India and China outbound travel markets
- Travel technology and digital innovation
- Hotel brand development and expansion
- Sustainable tourism and overtourism management
- Travel security and cybersecurity
- Corporate travel and remote work trends
- Mergers and acquisitions in travel tech
- Revenue management and customer cash investment
- Destination management (Middle East, North Africa, Portugal, Iceland)
- Airline operations and Boeing supply chain issues
- Consumer protection and booking platform regulation

## Travel Industry Intelligence & Research

- [Indian Outbound Traveler Insights and Segmentation Program](https://skift.com/india-outbound-travelers): Skift Advisory research program on India's outbound travel market
- [Iceland and the Trials of 21st Century Tourism](https://skift.com/iceland-tourism): Iceland overtourism challenges and sustainable destination management
- [Why India's Travel Market is at a Critical Inflection Point](https://skift.com/2026/02/25/why-indias-travel-market-is-at-a-critical-inflection-point): India's expanding travel economy faces infrastructure and distribution challenges
